_doc: Hand annotations of dataset/screens (shots referenced by their 3-digit sequence number). Used by tools/build_palette.py to build dataset/palette.json + templates, and by tests as ground truth. Grid cells (rows top=conveyor side, 0-based): '.' empty, 'x' not a grid cell, 'iceN' ice block with counter N, 'curN' cell covered by a curtain with counter N, '<color>-up|down' bucket, '<top>/<body>-up|down' tower bucket (top stage color / body color), 'lock:<colour>' lock icon (buckets underneath, opened by the key of the same colour), 'key:<colour>' key in its own cell, 'chestN' chest showing N (L186), 'mystery' grey mystery bucket with '?' (L186); a wall is a hole in the panel: 'x'. 'belts': settled conveyor buckets left to right (not the uncertain edge slots), '<top>/<next stage>' for a tower; 'sand_colors': colours in a shot's picture, when some have no visible bucket (hidden under curtains / locks). Rects are relative [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the iPhone screen.
